# @openlaunchsdk/core (v1.22.1)

HTTP, caching, queries and typed LL2 primitives. Install only the capabilities your application needs:

```sh
npm install @openlaunchsdk/core
```

```ts
import { HttpClient, MemoryCache, query } from '@openlaunchsdk/core';
```

No satellite.js or science dependency.

**Distribution:** generated by the monorepo build into `dist/esm`, `dist/cjs` and `dist/types`. The `openlaunch-sdk` umbrella remains the backwards-compatible umbrella package. Internal module subpaths are implementation details and not intended as stable public APIs.

Source: [kobyldav/openlaunch-sdk](https://github.com/kobyldav/openlaunch-sdk). MIT license. Flight/orbit calculations are research-grade, not safety qualified.
